text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to recommend installing stop controls for northbound and southbound traffic on Ridgecross Road at the north and south intersections of Ridgevalley Crescent. These intersections are currently uncontrolled and the installation of stop controls will define the right-of-way, enhancing traffic management and safety at these locations.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated Ridgevalley Crescent, from the north leg of Islington Avenue to the south leg of Islington Avenue, as a through highway.
